permission: Root authorized a bounded readonly investigation and sanitized long-term summary. Only abstract transport/config/maintenance metadata; raw source, request, response, business identities and machine paths remain local.
mode: Ordinary HTTP transport followup across existing source cohorts; no new model capability case or source/Test denominator
coverage: Exactly six previously named local event streams, three selected pairs; not a global failure census

interpretation.timing: Selected client END records fall close to the same ten-minute phase. Records are client observation times, not upstream packet capture; three selected groups do not establish a universal period or identify a timer.
interpretation.retry_scope: Each role retains the same task REQUEST path and canonical caller creates immutable body before its retry loop. Events explicitly label model_HTTP_only; this is not per-attempt wire-body capture or evidence the server generated only once.
interpretation.partial_policy: Failed attempts remain separate and are not concatenated or adopted. In the two newer groups automatic syntax is UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE_STREAM then VALID after complete retry; older RESULT without the field is not backfilled.
interpretation.syntax_vs_semantics: Final STOP/DONE or VALID does not grant semantic correctness, source adoption or business success. Source owners continue independently.

current_local_configuration.review_scope: Current shared caller/config only, not a proof of every external client or proxy effective timeout. No 600-second background timer exists in these reviewed paths; durations differ from the configured 180/900-second limits.

known_local_client_maintenance.mechanism: Synchronous task-entry local-date cache, not a scheduled periodic wakeup; no checker executed by this audit
known_local_client_maintenance.limits: Only this known cache/log/source; other local schedulers and remote service/gateway/OS maintenance UNKNOWN, not enumerated.

single_later_health_sample.source: Existing same-service documented endpoint; no route discovery or redirects
single_later_health_sample.limit: Later health200 with empty body proves only that sample. No previous uptime, restart absence, server queue or OOM diagnosis is inferred; no /metrics route guessed.

disposition: LIMITED_UNATTRIBUTED. Preserve exact attempts and continue real source work; no caller/config/service modification or artificial chat was justified.

owner_cost.review: Bounded existing logs/config/cache/docs and one authorized health sample only; no tests or process/task scans
